'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Westergard LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
